newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse edges higher, volume falls back.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse edges higher, volume falls back.

text.p: Share prices were generally higher where changed on the Ghana stock exchange on Monday, but volume was back to recent low levels after a rise on Friday caused by transactions in Social Security Bank (SSB).
The All-Share Index added 1.58 points to 395.17.
Volume was just 129,400 shares, with UTC Estates accounting for a third of that. UTC shares added five cedis to 70.

Another large block of 6.04 million Ghana Commercial Bank shares was on offer, but only 29,000 changed hands, according to the bourse report. The price rose five cedis to 575. Ashanti Goldfields added 100 to 21,800.
There were no fallers on Monday.
